item.title: 'The Terminal List': Chris Pratt Confirms Proper Season 3 Will Adapt 'Savage Son' Novel In "Exciting Shift"
item.description: Chris Pratt is giving audiences a meaty update concerning the future of his series " The Terminal List ," revealing which book from the series, created by author Jack Carr , it will adapt, giving some idea of where the third season could be going (Season 2 being an adaptation of " True Believer "). After confirming to ScreenRant that the next season of the Prime show would adapt the novel " Savage Son ," Pratt, who is promoting his new family comedy " Way of the Warrior Kid ," went on to tell the outlet about how they're planning on moving forward with the show and made it clear it won't be a spinoff like " Dark Wolf ," but part of that third season. Continue reading 'The Terminal List': Chris Pratt Confirms Proper Season 3 Will Adapt 'Savage Son' Novel In "Exciting Shift" at The Playlist.
